n5b621e69690.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Primary Health Centre (PHC)?
o: It serves as the referral centre for Sub Health Centres
Its population norm in plain areas is 30,000
It belongs to the secondary healthcare tier
Its population norm in hilly and tribal areas is 20,000
n5b621e69690.x: The PHC is the referral unit for SHCs but belongs to the primary tier; the CHC is the secondary-tier facility.

n2bd244832db.s: Which digital health platform provides connectivity among cancer centres?
n2bd244832db.x: ONCONET links cancer centres; Tele-MANAS is for mental health and SeHAT serves the armed forces.

ne8df6062a3b.s: At rural Community Health Centres in India, the highest vacancies are found in which posts?
ne8df6062a3b.x: Specialist posts at rural CHCs have high vacancies (shortfall of about 80%), while the nurse ratio is also below global norms.

n0c68ee5304b.s: The Under-Five Mortality Rate (U5MR) is expressed per how many live births?
n0c68ee5304b.x: U5MR, like IMR, uses a base of 1,000 live births; only the MMR uses 1,00,000.

nae8e0f3590e.s: According to the Economic Survey 2025-26, India's life expectancy in 2023 was:
nae8e0f3590e.x: Life expectancy rose from 49.7 years (1973) to 70.3 years (2023); 68.3 is the older SRS 2011-15 figure and 72.2 is AP's female figure.

nc9b9e7b412e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about POSHAN Abhiyaan?
o: It works through convergence of ICDS, NHM and Swachh Bharat
It aims to reduce stunting, wasting, anaemia and low birth weight
It is under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
nc9b9e7b412e.x: POSHAN Abhiyaan (2018) is under the Ministry of Women and Child Development, not the Health Ministry.

n3e618f6a50f.s: Anganwadi Services under ICDS cover children of which age group, besides pregnant and lactating women?
n3e618f6a50f.x: Anganwadi Services cover children from six months to six years, and pregnant and lactating women.

nac10466581c.s: How does the National Family Health Survey report child malnutrition?
o: As one single overall malnutrition percentage
As wasting alone, excluding stunting and underweight
As stunting, wasting and underweight separately
nac10466581c.x: NFHS reports stunting, wasting and underweight as separate indicators and gives no single overall malnutrition percentage.

nda12cb02171.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the 15th Finance Commission health grants is correctly matched?
o: Coverage – only urban health and wellness centres
nda12cb02171.x: The 15th FC recommended ₹70,051 crore for 2021–26 through local governments, covering rural and building-less SCs/PHCs/CHCs too, not only urban HWCs.

nba61393491f.s: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva in Andhra Pradesh is implemented in convergence with which scheme, enabling portability and wider empanelment?
nba61393491f.x: The AP scheme runs in convergence with PM-JAY, providing portability and wider hospital empanelment.

new.s: What is the population norm for a Community Health Centre (CHC) in plain areas?
new.x: A CHC serves 1,20,000 people in plain areas and 80,000 in hilly/tribal areas.

new.s: As per Health Dynamics of India 2022-23, how many district hospitals did India have?
new.x: Health Dynamics of India 2022-23 reports 714 district hospitals, along with 6,359 CHCs.

new.s: Which of the following committee–recommendation pairs is correctly matched?
o: Kartar Singh Committee – Multipurpose health workers
new.x: Kartar Singh (1973) recommended multipurpose health workers; Mudaliar wanted PHCs consolidated and Shrivastava proposed village health guides.

new.s: The Shrivastava Committee (1975) is known for recommending:
new.x: Shrivastava recommended community volunteers called village health guides and a Referral Services Complex.

new.s: Which committee recommended consolidating existing PHCs before expanding them?
new.x: The Mudaliar Committee (1959–62) asked for consolidation of existing PHCs and stronger district hospitals.

new.s: The Indian Public Health Standards 2022 lay down norms for which of the following?
o: SHC/HWC, PHC, CHC, sub-district and district hospitals
new.x: IPHS 2022, the latest revision, sets norms for SHC/HWC, PHC, CHC, sub-district and district hospitals.

new.s: Ayushman Arogya Mandirs follow the facility norms of:
new.x: Ayushman Arogya Mandirs follow IPHS 2022, the latest revision of the standards.

new.s: By 2026, the number of functioning Ayushman Arogya Mandirs was more than:
new.x: More than 1.79 lakh AAMs were functioning in 2026; 1,50,000 was the December 2022 figure.

new.s: Health and Wellness Centres (now Ayushman Arogya Mandirs) were set up by upgrading which facilities?
new.x: HWCs were created in 2018 by upgrading SHCs and PHCs and were later renamed Ayushman Arogya Mandirs.

new.s: eSanjeevani OPD is a telemedicine service of which type?
new.x: eSanjeevani OPD links patients at home to providers; eSanjeevani AAM is provider-to-provider (hub-and-spoke).

new.s: What is India's doctor-population ratio (NMC-registered allopathic doctors)?
new.x: India's ratio is about 1:834, better than the WHO norm of 1:1000, though doctors cluster in cities.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about specialists at rural CHCs (March 2023):
1. Only 4,413 of the 21,964 required specialists were in place.
2. The shortfall was about 80%.
3. Kerala had the largest gap.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: About 4,413 of 21,964 specialists were available, a shortfall of about 80%; Uttar Pradesh, not Kerala, had the largest gap.

new.s: In India, the private sector's share of outpatient care is about:
new.x: The private sector provides about 70% of outpatient care and over 60% of inpatient care.

new.s: The number of medical colleges in India rose from 387 in 2014 to how many in 2025?
new.x: Medical colleges grew from 387 (2014) to 819 (2025).

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the 108 service provides:
new.x: 108 is the emergency ambulance service; 104 is the mobile medical unit with health advisory.

new.s: How many Village Health Clinics does Andhra Pradesh have?
new.x: AP has 10,032 Village Health Clinics; 11,086 is the number of Sub Centres.

new.s: According to SRS 2020-22, India's Maternal Mortality Ratio was:
new.x: MMR fell from 97 (2018-20) to 93 (2019-21) and 88 (SRS 2020-22); 45 is AP's MMR.

new.s: The Neonatal Mortality Rate counts deaths of infants within the first:
new.x: NMR counts deaths in the first 28 days per 1,000 live births.

new.s: As per SRS 2020, Andhra Pradesh's Infant Mortality Rate was:
new.x: AP's IMR was 24 against India's 28 (SRS 2020); 35 was AP's NFHS-4 value.

new.s: As per SRS abridged life tables 2016-20, female life expectancy in Andhra Pradesh was:
new.x: AP's female life expectancy was 72.2 years, higher than India's 71.4; 69.1 is AP's male figure.

new.s: The replacement level of Total Fertility Rate is:
new.x: Replacement-level TFR is 2.1.

new.s: According to NFHS-5, India's Total Fertility Rate fell from 2.2 to:
new.x: NFHS-5 shows India's TFR at 2.0, below the replacement level of 2.1.

new.s: Which State had the highest Total Fertility Rate in NFHS-5?
new.x: Bihar had the highest TFR (3.0), followed by Meghalaya (2.9) and Uttar Pradesh (2.4).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Total Fertility Rate:
1. Andhra Pradesh's TFR is 1.5.
2. Five States were still above the replacement level in NFHS-5.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: AP's TFR is 1.5, and five States (Bihar, Meghalaya, UP, Jharkhand, Manipur) were above 2.1 in NFHS-5.

new.s: Which of the following was NOT included in NFHS-5?
new.x: NFHS-5 included pre-school education, menstrual hygiene and NCD screening, but not the HIV test.

new.s: Stunting in children refers to low:
new.x: Stunting is low height-for-age; wasting is low weight-for-height and underweight is low weight-for-age.

new.s: According to NFHS-5, stunting among children in Andhra Pradesh was:
new.x: AP's stunting was 31.2% in NFHS-5 (25% in NFHS-6); 35.5% is the national figure.

new.s: The 'triple burden' of malnutrition (SOFI 2025) adds which of the following to undernutrition and overweight?
new.x: The triple burden is undernutrition plus micronutrient deficiency/anaemia plus overweight.

new.s: According to SOFI 2025, India's child wasting rate, the world's highest, is:
new.x: SOFI 2025 puts India's wasting at 18.7% (21 million), the world's highest.

new.s: According to NFHS-5, what share of women had 10 or more years of schooling?
new.x: NFHS-5 found 41% of women had 10+ years of schooling, a driver of child nutrition.

new.s: PM POSHAN, launched in 2021, was renamed from which scheme?
new.x: PM POSHAN (2021) replaced the Mid-Day Meal scheme and covers Classes I–VIII plus Bal Vatika.

new.s: YSR Sampoorna Poshana Plus covers pregnant women, lactating mothers and children in how many tribal mandals?
new.x: YSR Sampoorna Poshana Plus (Sep 2020) covers the same groups in 77 tribal mandals.

new.s: Anna Amrutha Hastam in Andhra Pradesh mainly targets:
new.x: Anna Amrutha Hastam gives pregnant and lactating women a nutritious meal and iron-folic acid tablets through Anganwadis.

new.s: The first National Health Accounts estimates in India were prepared for the year:
new.x: India's first NHA was for 2013-14.

new.s: According to NHA 2022-23, the share of social security expenditure in Total Health Expenditure was:
new.x: Social security's share rose from 6% (2013-14) to 9.9% (2022-23).

new.s: Under the National Health Policy 2017, the Centre's share of public health spending was to be:
new.x: NHP 2017 set the Centre's share at 40% of public health spending, along with GHE of 2.5% of GDP by 2025.

new.s: The average cost of childbirth in private facilities is about ₹37,630, compared with how much in government facilities?
new.x: Childbirth costs about ₹37,630 privately against ₹2,299 in government facilities.

new.s: PM-JAY provides health cover of how much per family per year?
new.x: PM-JAY covers ₹5 lakh per family per year; ₹25 lakh is AP's Universal Health Policy cover.

new.s: In October 2024, PM-JAY was extended to all citizens aged 70 and above:
o: Only if not covered by any other scheme
new.x: The October 2024 extension covers all citizens aged 70+, irrespective of income, through the Ayushman Vay Vandana card.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 2024 PM-JAY extension for senior citizens:
1. Beneficiaries receive the Ayushman Vay Vandana card.
2. Members aged 70+ of already covered families get an extra ₹5 lakh top-up.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the 70+ cover uses the Ayushman Vay Vandana card and gives a ₹5 lakh top-up to already covered families.

new.s: Between 2017-18 and 2025, government-financed health insurance coverage in India rose by about:
new.x: NSS 80th round shows government-financed insurance up 2.5-fold.

new.s: According to NFHS-6, households with at least one insured member rose from 41.0% to:
new.x: NFHS-6 shows insured households rising from 41.0% to 60.2%.

new.s: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) was set up in:
new.x: NPPA was set up in 1997; it fixes ceiling prices under the Drugs Price Control Order 2013.

new.s: How many Jan Aushadhi Kendras had been opened by December 2025?
new.x: 17,990 Jan Aushadhi Kendras had opened by Dec 2025; 25,000 is the target for March 2027.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's Universal Health Policy (Sep 2025) provides cover of up to how much per family per year?
new.x: The policy offers up to ₹25 lakh per family per year covering all 3,257 procedures.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's Universal Health Policy (2025)?
o: Claims up to ₹2.5 lakh are handled through insurers
Employees under the Employee Health Scheme are included
Claims from ₹2.5 lakh to ₹25 lakh go through the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust
new.x: EHS employees are excluded from the Universal Health Policy; the other statements are correct.

new.s: Together with EHS, RSBY, ESIS and CGHS, AP's state health scheme covers about what share of AP households (2026)?
new.x: The state scheme with EHS, RSBY, ESIS and CGHS covers about 70% of AP households.
